name: Sample Tactics (starter set)
description: A small, verified starter set so the trainer works out of the box. Replace it by importing your own puzzle book. These positions are generic teaching examples, not from any published book.

puzzles.explanation: Ra8# is checkmate on the 8th rank. The black king is boxed in by its own f7/g7/h7 pawns and has no escape and nothing to block with.
Qe8# sweeps the whole 8th rank. Same pawn-cage idea as the rook mate, but with the queen.
a8=Q promotes the pawn to a new queen, winning decisive material. When a passed pawn reaches the last rank, always look at promoting first.
Nc7+ is a royal fork: it checks the king on a8 and simultaneously attacks the queen on e6. After the king moves, Nxe6 wins the queen.
1.Ra8+ forces 1...Qc8 (the only way to block the check), and 2.Rxc8# finishes on the back rank. A classic deflection-free back-rank mate in two.
Rxc1 simply wins the black rook that wandered onto c1, since it was undefended. Always check for hanging pieces before anything fancy.
